items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: That's Red Car U. That's Red Car U? I met him.

ctx.x: Did he have any crips? Huh? Did he have a real crip that he played or featured or anything?

What do you mean by a crip? One of his special numbers. Well, he was a good piano player. Yeah? Juby. I know Juby. He was a good piano player, too. Juby? Juby. Well, them fellas all come over 20, over 30 years ago, you know. Yeah. That's the fellas that I knew. Well, then when I was a young guy, too, you know. He was just coming up, playing. And I played in a lot of tongues. You know. And them, what you call it? Places where they, Forbidden to Sound of Laker. What you call it? Speakeasy. Speakeasy, yeah. Playing…
Oh, they had nothing but some good, you know. Which Willie is this? Willie? That's all I know.
